effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nThe Noble Sons Abroad (Pistoliers)\\nThe Bordermen (Outriders – Grenade Launchers)[[/col]]

name: Knights of the Empire
description: Those who try to escape the fray will find their flanks blocked by noble steel, ranged against the foe in the Emperor's name.

effect.name: [[col:green]]Unlocks recruitment of the following Elector Count State Troops:\\nKnights of Morr (Empire Knights)\\nKnights of the Everlasting Light (Empire Knights)\\nThe Stubborn Bulls (Empire Knights – Greatswords)[[/col]]

name: Divine Mandate
description: As more and more accursed books are sealed, bigger and bigger temples are built, and Sigmar’s blessings smile upon us.

effect.name: Effect range: %+n% for "Grand Hammer of Sigmar"
Effect range: %+n% for "Grand Shield of Faith"

name: Fanatic's Decree
description: “The damned will fear us as we push forwards with unbridled wrath – AND THEY WILL BE DESTROYED!”

effect.name: Missile resistance: %n% for Flagellants units
Speed: %+n% for Flagellants units
Upkeep: %+n% for Flagellant units

name: Thaumatic Locus
description: The Winds of Magic shift through a fountain of indescribable colours as, somewhere far beyond, the Raven laughs.

effect.name: Winds of Magic power reserve capacity: %+n

name: Arcane Surge
description: To look upon the standard of Tzeentch, crawling with eldritch, multi-hued symbols and tempestuous energies, is to look upon madness writ in living cloth.

effect.name: Cooldown: %+n% to Lores of Tzeentch and Metal spells

name: Way of Deception
description: Vision is illusion. In this, we are all of us but the puppets of Tzeeneth, and he severs and re-ties our strings at will.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Reveal Shroud"

name: Locus of Transmogrification
description: The flesh writhes and warps, taking on ever-changing, disorientating new forms most minds cannot focus on, seeming even to spasm in and out of existence.

effect.name: Recruit rank: %+n for Blue Horrors of Tzeentch, Pink Horrors of Tzeentch and Exalted Pink Horrors of Tzeentch units

name: Piercing Screams
description: The sound is a chilling howl from the void, a siren song of madness that strips reason from even the strongest mind.

effect.name: Melee defence: %+n for Cockatrice units
Charge bonus: %+n for Screamers of Tzeentch units
Enables charmed attacks for Screamers of Tzeentch

name: Way of Fate
description: The iridescent waters of the Well of Eternity reveal all to Tzeentch's patient gaze.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Force Peace"

name: Way of War
description: Bony knuckles inside the brain, kneading, coaxing, enraging – stoking eternal hatred.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Force War"

name: Bolt of Change
description: Such power there is in words. Power that belongs only to the Raven God.

effect.name: Army ability: "Bolt of Change"

name: Exalted Locus of Conjuration
description: The witless mortals call it 'magic'. Here is the truth of the matter: this great energy is Change itself given eldritch form, and Tzeentch decrees to whom it is allocated.

effect.name: Ammunition: %+n% for Blue Horrors of Tzeentch, Pink Horrors of Tzeentch and Exalted Pink Horrors of Tzeentch units
Weapon strength: %+n% for Blue Horrors of Tzeentch, Pink Horrors of Tzeentch and Exalted Pink Horrors of Tzeentch units

name: Way of Deceit
description: The Changer of Ways sees the secret hatred within, the simmering greed behind the mask of friendship. That is how He makes puppets of us all.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Force Rebellion"

name: Storm of Fire
description: Blue and gold are His colours. Nine is His number. The Raven is His totem. Infinite is His knowledge.

effect.name: Army ability: "Storm of Fire"

name: Metallurgical Morphism
description: Which caused which – the writhing, sanity-stripping runes or the unnaturally shifting steel that bears them? Only Tzeentch knows.

effect.name: Armour: %+n for Chaos Warriors of Tzeentch, Chosen of Tzeentch and Chaos Knights of Tzeentch units

name: Way of Time
description: Time is but a mirage, a self-deception employed by mortals to impose order upon madness. Should the Changer will it this futile illusion may be dispelled.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Track Army"

name: Way of Manipulation
description: From the shadows, He watches. He sees the darkness behind the lies. He pulls at unseen strings, and summons forth tumult and turmoil.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Halt Army"

name: Temporal Switch
description: All of this has happened before, and all of this shall happen again and again. Only Tzeentch decides the when.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Break Alliance"

name: Way of Prognostication
description: Only a fool believes they make their own choices. The Great Conspirator has known their mind since the moment of their creation.

effect.name: Changing of the Ways: "Open Gates"
